content: संप्रदायः .²1 Tradition, traditional doctrine or knowledge, traditional handing down of instruction; चन्द्रकेतुरवाप्तदिव्यास्त्रसंप्रदायः <ls>U. 2. 7/8</ls>; अथ तत् संप्रदायेन रामभद्रे स्थिता अपि <ls n="U.">5. 15</ls>. .²2 A peculiar system of religious teaching, a religious doctrine inculcating the worship of one peculiar deity. .²3 An established custom, usage. .²4 Gift (संप्रदान); दिव्यास्त्रसंप्रदायोऽयं लक्ष्मणेन सहास्तु मे <ls>Mv. 1. 47</ls>. (Also <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>U. 2. 7/8.</ls>)
